smoke.selectionRule: Nearest three distinct sites among five audited within 50 km, preferring >=75% hourly coverage over 60 days. If none qualify, show partial records with gaps. Prefer comparable reference instrument within each site. Not fire-attributed smoke.

dnbr.license: There are no restrictions on use, except for reasonable and proper acknowledgement of information sources and limitations as preliminary/draft data.
dnbr.processing: Source dNBR /1000; existing continuous ramp at -0.2, 0.15, 0.5, 0.85, 1.2; no severity thresholds; nearest-neighbor Web Mercator display; source masks, approved numeric exclusions, nonfinite pixels and Census water transparent
dnbr.limitation: Preliminary BAER imagery context; not a field-checked severity classification. Terrain and water context are not acquisition-date measurements.

match.matchingRule: Exact name and ignition day; one BAER agency location strictly inside the original fire polygon; no date tolerance or nearest match

sources.title: USGS 1/3 Arc Second n36w119 20260610
sources.processing: Native-grid window plus 20-cell derivative buffer; not a complete copy of the source tile.

slope.processing: Native elevation windows; bilinear reprojection to a metre-based 10 m NAD83 UTM grid; central-difference slope in degrees; 0-90 degree check before thresholding; rectangle extending 3 km past each edge of the fire's projected bounding box; nearest-neighbor class rendering to Web Mercator PNG. Water and no-data transparent.
slope.limitation: Elevation editions are not fire-date measurements. Display is resampled; no extra spatial detail is created. Census water is not date-matched; invalid water polygons are omitted and listed in the water source record. This is terrain, not a watershed or a debris-flow estimate.
slope.analysisMask: Rectangle extending 3 km past each edge of the verified fire boundary's projected bounding box
